title: Parameter-Level Attribution of Symmetry in Trained Networks Though Parameter-Wise Functional Sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2608.24700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a network has learned a function with a known symmetry, can that symmetry be moved through the parametrisation---is there a motion in parameter space realising the group action in function space? We formulate this as a lifting problem for the realisation map $\Phi:\theta\mapsto f_\theta$, and show that a smooth parameter-space action exists only if the tangent space to the function's symmetry orbit lies within the image of $\mathrm d\Phi_\theta$, whose columns are the \emph{functional sensitivities} of individual parameters. This condition is also sufficient for pointwise first-order lifting. Relaxing it in least squares yields two local parameter directions: one following the symmetry orbit, one descending towards the equivariant subspace, with residuals measuring what the parametrisation cannot reach. On a rotationally invariant classifier we find these directions induce their predicted function-space motion, but only locally: rec

translated_title: 训练网络中对称性的参数级归因：基于参数级功能敏感度
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24700v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当网络学习了一个具有已知对称性的函数时，该对称性能否通过参数化传递——即参数空间中是否存在一种运动，在函数空间中实现群作用？我们将此表述为实现映射 $\Phi:\theta\mapsto f_\theta$ 的提升问题，并证明：仅当函数对称轨道的切空间位于 $\mathrm d\Phi_\theta$ 的像（其列是各参数的\emph{功能敏感度}）内时，才存在光滑的参数空间作用。此条件也是逐点一阶提升的充分条件。在最小二乘意义下放宽该条件，可得到两个局部参数方向：一个沿对称轨道，另一个下降至等变子空间，其残差度量了参数化无法达到的部分。在旋转不变分类器上，我们发现这些方向诱导了预测的函数空间运动，但仅局部有效：重新计算后，效果会减弱。
tldr: 本文通过参数级功能敏感度分析，提出了对称性在训练网络参数空间中可实现提升的充要条件，并揭示了局部有效的参数方向，用于归因和近似对称性。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates the lifting of function-space symmetry to parameter space via functional sensitivity, proving a necessary and sufficient condition for smooth lifting and identifying local parameter directions that approximate the symmetry orbit, with residuals indicating parametric limitations.
